0022600132.text: The Miami Heat (0-4) visit the Atlanta Hawks (2-2) for the Heat's fifth game of the season, looking to snap a four-game losing streak while sitting 5th in the Southeast and 15th in the East. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Miami won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 143-117 win in Miami on April 12, 2026. Pelle Larsson (ankle sprain) and Simone Fontecchio (illness) are listed as day-to-day for Miami, with both game-time decisions, while Atlanta has Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) out and Aaron Wiggins (knee bruise) listed as day-to-day.
